title: A stuck or replaced dispatch cannot release
summary: GitHub can hold a dispatched run queued or pending with zero jobs and refuse to cancel it. Past the stall threshold the stage fails as ci_run_never_started, naming the run's real status and the re-drive `yoke --env <plane> watch deploy -- <RUN> --from-stage <STAGE> --fresh`; without --fresh the re-drive reattaches to the stuck run. A fresh dispatch is a newer intent in the same deploy stage scope, and right before its tag the release bridge asks whether its own dispatch is still that stage's newest intent. A replaced bridge exits cleanly with a named notice and tags, builds and promotes nothing.
recipes: yoke github-actions dispatch-intent current CORRELATION-ID --project P --json
